added.member: probe command actions: dump_physics, dump_audio, expect:audio
added.summary: Added non-publish `dump_physics[:path]` (gravity, body/collider counts, tracked bodies, joints, active solid contacts and sensor overlaps, characters, vehicles, ragdolls, soft bodies, fluids, step timings) and `dump_audio[:path]` (bus gains, stream hash, active voices with playheads, user buses, snapshots, music clocks, reverb zones, listeners, sound bank residency, recent listen peak/RMS, and mixer render stats), plus `expect:audio:[<sec>:]<audible|silent|<metric><op><value>>` (unchecked when no audio listener hook is installed).

added.member: og explore UI and pointer game support
added.summary: Extended `og explore` to support `mouse.left` / `touch` button bindings and dynamically discover interactive UI controls via `probe.dump({ what: "ui" })`, issuing atomic `touch_move_to` / `move_to_text` + `touch_start` / `touch_end` click units that shrink and replay deterministically.

added.member: og dev native in-place dev_refresh and project.ogt watch
added.summary: Exposed `og_node_dev_refresh` on the native host and wired `og dev` + `run.ts` (`--watch-refresh`) to refresh cooked assets/UI in place on asset-only edits without re-bundling or reloading the world, and to watch `project.ogt` for automatic re-cook, re-bundle, and clean restart.

fixed.member: probe view and turntable camera framing
fixed.summary: Fixed `view` and `turntable` bounds calculation to frame posed/deformed `skinned_instances` and rotated/anchored `sprites` alongside static meshes.
